title: docs: guest has no bind door until ADR-0138 D3 item 5's door is built (ADR-0090 D9 line, two docblocks)
body:
Fixes #23373

Clause-②: no

## What

Three texts still described a `guest` bind or suggestion path that no door has. Ruling C on #23267 (`6159279205`), recorded by PR #23370 in ADR-0138 D3 item 5, says the guest's bind door is built implementation-first, and until then no door binds a set to `guest`. This PR makes each site say what holds: `everyone` takes package suggestions and admin confirmations, and `guest` has no bind door until ADR-0138 D3 item 5's door is built (an act of the environment's administrator, never of a package).

| Site | Change |
|---|---|
| `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md` | One new `Amended` line in the status block, pointing at ADR-0138 D3 item 5: D9's last bullet holds for `everyone` alone, and its `guest` half is superseded. ⛔ D9's decision text is not rewritten (AGENTS.md rule 13, triage `6159891022`). |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` | The rule-table row (`:14`), the module docblock (`:29`-`:37`) and the `isDefault` scope comment (`:935`-`:938`) stop saying "an operator binds to `guest` at install time" and "judged by the bind-time gate alone". No such gate or door exists. |
| `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` | The anchor docblock says packages suggest `everyone` bindings only, and that no door binds `guest` until ADR-0138 D3 item 5's door is built. |

No behaviour moves: no code, no `.describe()`, no schema and no rule logic changes.

## Changeset: `skip-changeset`

Measured on the built tree: the new `position.zod.ts` sentence ships in `@objectstack/spec`'s `dist/*.d.ts` (JSDoc) and in `src/**/*.zod.ts` (the package's `files[]`). `@objectstack/lint`'s `dist/` strips comments, so it has 0 hits. The pre-existing sibling sentence served as the positive control and hit the same two spec `.d.ts` files. The only shipped bytes that change are comment text, which falls under os-dev's comment fast-track (comments do not publish), so no changeset is added.

## Verification (head `20ec48e`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 139 files, 6771 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 680 files, 20784 passed, 1 todo.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 77 commands for this diff. 75 ran with exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone, then passed.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` and `pnpm check:dev-prereqs`. They need a whole-workspace build, so they exit 3 or 1 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET before reaching their bodies. This narrowing is declared, and CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- One sibling text stays out of scope: `docs/adr/0086-authz-metadata-config-boundary-and-cross-package-composition.md:444` reads "`everyone` / `guest` built-in positions … Packages *suggest* bindings; admins confirm". It is a governed ADR outside this card's claimed file surface, and it is reported to the seat.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:三处文字(ADR-0090 D9 的状态块新增一行修订说明,`validate-security-posture.ts` 与 `position.zod.ts` 的注释),不再说"包可以建议、或运维可以绑定 `guest` 权限集"。现在的说法是:`everyone` 可以由包建议、由管理员确认;`guest` 在 ADR-0138 D3 第 5 项的绑定入口建成之前,任何入口都不能绑定。

**为什么改**:#23267 的裁决 C 已经定下:我们和 Salesforce 类似,暂时没有公开站点或门户的产品计划,所以 guest 的绑定入口等有具名部署需要时再建。旧文字仍把一条并不存在的路径写成现成的,AI 或作者读了会以为能给 guest 绑权限集。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文字,不动任何行为,不发版本(注释走快速通道,不加 changeset)。ADR 只追加一行修订说明,D9 原决定文本未改写。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:这是 Tier H(改动了 `docs/adr/**`),需要你亲手批准或合并。
